answer: Re-attestations are stored in nebula and grove lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 11 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the yarrow graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 455 impostors cost 1784 times the honest price and take 3 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
